plugins.name: ste-writing
plugins.description: ASD-STE100 simplified writing + anti-AI-style rewriter. Based on ASD-STE100 Issue 9 (2025-01-15) core writing rules with a 12-point anti-AI-style checklist. Three modes: rewrite (zero information loss), write (BLUF drafting with self-check), audit (rule-by-row diagnosis). Works for both English and Chinese output.
